product.name: Karbon Business Inward Remittance
product.description: A cross-border payment service for Indian businesses, freelancers, exporters, and marketplace sellers to receive international payments and settle funds into Indian bank accounts.

product.name: Karbon Business Outward Remittance
product.description: A business payment service for sending funds from India to overseas suppliers, contractors, and service providers in multiple currencies with transaction tracking and compliance support.

product.name: Karbon Corporate Card
product.description: A prepaid corporate card and expense-management service for controlling business spending, tracking transactions, and generating expense reports.

product.name: Karbon Invoice Financing
product.description: A financing service that provides working capital against unpaid invoices, with stated funding amounts of ₹10 lakh to ₹50 lakh and no collateral requirement.

product.name: Karbon Cloud Discounts
product.description: A cloud-cost procurement service that helps businesses obtain reduced pricing on cloud services through partner arrangements without long-term commitments.

product.name: AI Accountant
product.description: An AI-based accounting automation service designed to reduce manual bookkeeping and accounting tasks for accountants and businesses.
